将一张照片变成可探索的 3D 画面

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的图片。任何单张照片、渲染或 AI 生成的图像。该主题的一个清晰视图就是模型的全部需求。适用于：产品照片·建筑·人物渲染·风景·室内

第 2 步：点击运行。没有提示，没有设置。 SHARP 估计深度和几何形状，构建高斯 Splat，并加载实时 3D 预览，您可以在工作流程中直接运行。

步骤 3. 下载 PLY 文件。输出是包含 3D splat 的标准 PLY。将其导入任何兼容的查看器或引擎中。适用于：SuperSplat · Unity · Unreal · Blender · 任何 3DGS 渲染器

第一次？上传图像并点击运行。没有要更改的设置。默认值处理一切。

概述

此工作流程使用 SHARP（Apple Research 的开源模型）将单张照片转换为 3D 高斯 Splat。它读取一张图像，估计深度、几何形状和与视图相关的外观，并在一秒内将 splat 输出为 PLY 文件。您可以在下载之前获得实时 3D 预览来进行轨道和检查，这样您就可以在不离开浏览器的情况下判断结果。它从一个视图开始工作，因此您可以跳过 3D 重建通常需要的多视图捕获、摄影测量装备和相机校准。你上传一张照片，点击运行，大约 18 秒后，splat 就准备好了。没有提示，没有要连接的节点。

适用对象：游戏开发者、视觉特效艺术家和电子商务团队，他们希望在 ComfyUI 中获得单图像 3D splats，而无需从头开始连接推理节点。不适合：完整的、全方位的 3D 模型。 SHARP 从一个视点构建，因此相机无法看到的内容并不在拍图中。当您需要完整的几何图形时，请使用多视图或网格管道。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的照片。

  2. 打跑。无需提示。绕行 3D 预览以检查结果。

  3. 下载 PLY 文件，为任何 3DGS 查看器或引擎做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每次运行大约在 18 秒内返回，模型本身的推断时间不到一秒，因此批量转换一组照片的速度很快。有两件事决定结果。光线充足的图像具有清晰的深度和可见的表面细节，可产生更密集、更清晰的斑点，而平坦的白色墙壁、空白的天空和曝光不足的照片则显得嘈杂或稀疏。如果结果看起来被拉伸或扁平化，则说明焦距已关闭，因此请根据 EXIF 将 focus_length_mm 设置为您的实际镜头值，或者向上微移以使其变平，向下微移以加深透视。 SHARP 已获得 MIT 许可，因此您的 splat 可以用于商业用途。

使用案例

产品 3D 资产。将产品照片转变为可探索的 3D 资产，用于电子商务、AR 预览或 3D 目录，无需扫描仪。

建筑与室内设计。从一张内部或外部照片生成一个splat，以供空间参考和客户演练。

3D 参考概念。将概念艺术或 AI 图像转换为粗略的 3D 场景，以便在完整 CG 构建之前进行相机规划和照明测试。

游戏和视觉特效预览。在建模之前，从参考照片中遮挡环境、道具或角色。

SHARP 可以将什么变成 3D splat？

o.en:
Turn one photo into an explorable 3D splat

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your image. Any single photo, render, or AI-generated image. One clear view of the subject is all the model needs. Works great with: product photos · architecture · character renders · landscapes · interiors

Step 2. Hit run. No prompt, no settings. SHARP estimates depth and geometry, builds the Gaussian Splat, and loads a live 3D preview you can orbit right in the workflow.

Step 3. Download the PLY file. The output is a standard PLY holding the 3D splat. Import it into any compatible viewer or engine. Ready for: SuperSplat · Unity · Unreal · Blender · any 3DGS renderer

First time? Upload an image and hit run. There are no settings to change. The defaults handle everything.

Overview

This workflow turns a single photo into a 3D Gaussian Splat using SHARP, an open-source model from Apple Research. It reads one image, estimates depth, geometry, and view-dependent appearance, and outputs a splat as a PLY file in under a second. You get a live 3D preview to orbit and inspect before you download, so you can judge the result without leaving the browser. It works from one view, so you skip the multi-view capture, the photogrammetry rig, and the camera calibration that 3D reconstruction usually needs. You upload a photo, hit run, and the splat is ready in about 18 seconds. No prompt, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: game developers, VFX artists, and e-commerce teams who want single-image 3D splats in ComfyUI without wiring the inference nodes from scratch. Not for: a full, all-sides 3D model. SHARP builds from one viewpoint, so what the camera cannot see is not in the splat. Use a multi-view or mesh pipeline when you need complete geometry.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your photo.

  2. Hit run. No prompt needed. Orbit the 3D preview to check the result.

  3. Download the PLY file, ready for any 3DGS viewer or engine.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each run comes back in about 18 seconds, and the model itself infers in under a second, so batch-converting a set of photos stays quick. Two things decide the result. Well-lit images with clear depth and visible surface detail give denser, cleaner splats, while flat white walls, blank sky, and underexposed shots read as noisy or sparse. If a result looks stretched or flattened, the focal length is off, so set focal_length_mm to your real lens value from EXIF, or nudge it up to flatten and down to deepen the perspective. SHARP is MIT licensed, so your splats are yours to use commercially.

Use Cases

Product 3D Assets. Turn a product photo into an explorable 3D asset for e-commerce, AR previews, or 3D catalogs, no scanner needed.

Architecture & Interiors. Generate a splat from one interior or exterior photo for spatial reference and client walkthroughs.

Concept to 3D Reference. Convert concept art or an AI image into a rough 3D scene for camera planning and lighting tests before a full CG build.

Game & VFX Previz. Block out environments, props, or characters from reference photos before modeling.
